messages:
ria: quick ping 1 bringing up a new embed family 'marigold-lite' on wiki holdout. overall recall@10 close but short queries (<6 tokens) show a consistent top1/top3 collapse. sharing numbers and plan.
dave: paste the exact numbers + eval flags pls.
sylvie: also include which pooling/ln changes were made in this variant.
ria: short table pasted:
```
baseline beacon-v2 fp16    recall@10 = 0.648
marigold-lite fp16         recall@10 = 0.636  (-0.012)
marigold-lite int8 pchan   recall@10 = 0.631  (-0.017)
recall@1 (shortseq): baseline 0.412 -> marigold 0.335 (-0.077)
mean pos cosine: 0.79 -> 0.72
```
flags: `--model marigold-lite --holdout wiki --k 10 --norm cosine --seed 99` artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/marigold/v0/quick/ (UMAP, id-flip csv, histograms)
noah: big drop in recall@1 for short queries is worrying. is it rank shift or id-flips?
ria: ran topk-overlap: shortseq top1 overlap 0.78 -> 0.54, top10 overlap 0.94 -> 0.85. so many id-flips and some disappearances.
dave: what changed in model? pooling/ln/temperature/scale?
ria: differences: replaced mean-pool with gated-attn-pool, moved final LN before projection (post-proj LN removed), reduced projection width from 768->512. trained with heavier dropout.
sylvie: gated pooling + width cut could reduce signal for very short contexts. did you inspect embedding norm distribution and per-dim mean?
ria: yes 1 short queries have lower mean norm and broader variance. pos-sim histogram shifted left by ~0.06. per-dim mean shows a small global offset. UMAP sample in artifacts shows shortseq positives less clustered.
noah: quick mitigations to try: 1) global mean-centering + renorm 2) PCA-whiten k=64 indexing 3) per-dim bias subtract 4) ablation to restore projection width and mean-pooling.
dave: also run quant calibration sweep (per-tensor vs per-channel, symmetric vs asymmetric, percentile clipping). sometimes int8 exaggerates low-norm vector distortion.
ria: did quick center+renorm: recall@10 -> 0.642, recall@1(short) -> 0.362 (partial recovery). PCA-whiten k=64 -> recall@1 0.369. so postproc helps but doesn't fully close gap.
sylvie: can you produce 50 human-readable failure cases (query, gold-id, beacon-rank, marigold-rank, beacon-sim, marigold-sim)? helpful for model folks.
ria: yes will add CSV to artifacts. also plan ablations: A) revert to mean-pool, B) revert width->768, C) move LN back to pre-projection. will run cohorts: short/medium/long.
noah: include id-flip overlap matrix and a small script output showing whether positives moved from top1->top5 or out of top10. that helps quantify severity.
dave: if ablation shows width or pooling as culprit, model change is the fix. if centering recovers most signal, we can ship index-time centering for Dedicated as short-term mitigation (document perf tradeoffs).
ci-bot: eval pipeline queued: job marigold-lite-onboard-20260408-01. logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/marigold-lite-onboard-20260408-01/logs. artifacts will land in s3 path above.
sylvie: also request paired t-test on pos-sim means for shortseq baseline vs marigold (p-value + effect size) in the artifacts.
ria: will attach stats + small notebook for visualization. kicking jobs now, ETA ~40m for first pass. will update thread when jobs finish. :thumbsup:
